designSystem.note: Ignores below are decisions, not oversights. Each one has a reason and a reviewer. They were re-reviewed when the site moved from the monochrome Geist register to the inspection-report register. The cream-palette rule was added after the 2026-11-03 audit, when the detector flagged the paper ground that the selected direction is built on.

marketing-buzzword.reason: The site quotes the CV's own language (RPO/RTO targets for mission-critical Splunk, ARC certification). That wording is verified against career-ops/cv.md and must not drift. The inspection-report register adds verdict vocabulary (PASS, IN REVIEW) that is status, not marketing, and is always paired with the record it refers to. Currently zero hits on the live site; the rule is retained so a future edit cannot soften a verified CV phrase into a marketing adjective.

hero-eyebrow-chip.reason: The mono uppercase eyebrow is a binding product decision, not decoration. In the inspection-report register it carries real information in one of three forms: a count on an index page ('11 projects', '6 credentials'), a category on a detail page ('Infrastructure', 'Security Tooling'), or the report doctype on a page header ('PRÜFPROTOKOLL · INSPECTION REPORT'). The homepage letterhead replaces the old positioning-eyebrow chip with a report header block that states the document type, the subject, and the issue. Eyebrows that merely restate their own h1 were removed rather than ignored.
hero-eyebrow-chip.reviewer: ankit-portfolio-builder skill, Conventions: eyebrows carry information

overused-font.reason: IBM Plex Sans + IBM Plex Mono is the binding typographic identity of this site. It was chosen with Ankit from five presented directions and replaced the earlier Geist/Geist Mono pairing. The self-hosted WOFF2 subsets include Latin, Latin Extended, and dedicated symbol files for U+2192 and U+2197, so the arrow glyphs in the report cannot fall back to a system font. Changing the typeface again is a rebrand, not a fix, and requires Ankit's explicit sign-off.
overused-font.reviewer: ankit-portfolio-builder skill, Conventions: the inspection-report register is binding

cream-palette.reason: The warm paper ground (#F8F6EF) is the defining surface of the inspection-report register that Ankit selected from five presented directions. It is a deliberate material choice: the page is a sheet of technical paper on a desk, not a neutral screen background. The value is not a reflex off-white, it is the paper tone of the source sketches, and it is paired with a deliberately non-neutral ink (#1C1B16, warm black), ruled hairline borders in a warm grey, and a rust verdict colour, so the page reads as one material rather than a tinted neutral. The rule would still be worth applying to any future section that adds a cream ground on top of the paper without a material reason for it.
cream-palette.reviewer: ankit-portfolio-builder skill, Conventions: the inspection-report register is binding
